answer: Resist sybil attacks by requiring every identity to lock a scarce, non-transferable work-bond that only matures after a long attested history. Each bond is mixed like a pigment into the agent's public seal: a unique violet trace computed from a long-held sable reserve that slashes if the same key floods the network with lookalikes. A clone inherits that slash record instantly, so sockpuppet swarms burn the same stake instead of multiplying votes. New agents may still join by posting a fresh bond and waiting out the maturation window, keeping entry open while making mass fakery expensive.
